meta.name: Audit websites from Telegram with GPT-4o-mini and log results to Google Sheets

name: Telegram bot that audits any website with GPT

nodes.name: Receive Telegram message
nodes.notes:
Listens for any message sent to your Telegram bot.

How to connect:
1. Get Bot Token from @BotFather on Telegram
2. In n8n: Settings → Credentials → Add New → Telegram API
3. Paste the token and connect to this node

The bot accepts messages from ANY Telegram user.
To restrict to specific users, add an IF node after this
that checks message.from.id against an allowed list.

nodes.name: Set config
nodes.notes:
REPLACE THESE 2 VALUES ONLY:

1. sheetId
   Open your Google Sheet in browser
   URL: docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ABC123/edit
   Copy the part between /d/ and /edit
   Create a tab called: Website Audits
   Row 1 headers:
   Date | Website URL | Business Type | Score | Top Issues | Quick Wins | Key Recommendation | Requested By | Logged At

2. senderName
   Your name for audit records
   Example: Rahul Dutt

The Telegram chat ID is read from the incoming message automatically.
No hardcoding needed — bot works for any user who messages it.

nodes.name: Find a URL in the message
nodes.notes:
Reads the Telegram message and checks if it contains a URL.

If a URL is found:
- hasUrl = true
- websiteUrl = the extracted URL
- Workflow proceeds to scrape and analyze

If no URL found (user sent 'hi', 'help', or anything else):
- hasUrl = false
- helpMessage is prepared
- Bot sends a friendly explanation

Also extracts the chat ID to know where to send the reply.
No changes needed.

nodes.name: Was a URL sent?
nodes.notes:
TRUE — message contains a valid URL — proceed to scrape and analyze
FALSE — no URL found — send help message

No changes needed.

nodes.name: Fetch the website
nodes.notes:
Fetches the HTML content of the submitted website.

timeout: 15 seconds
onError: continueRegularOutput — if scraping fails, workflow continues
and the Clean HTML node sends a graceful error message

If a website consistently fails:
- It may be blocking bot requests
- Try adding a User-Agent header: Mozilla/5.0
- Or use a Firecrawl node instead of HTTP Request

No credentials needed for public websites.

nodes.name: Strip the HTML down to text
nodes.notes:
Converts raw HTML into clean readable text for GPT.

Removes: nav, footer, header, scripts, styles
Preserves: main body text and headings
Decodes: HTML entities
Caps: at 4000 characters

If the scrape failed, passes a fallback message so the
workflow continues and bot replies with an error message.

No changes needed.

nodes.name: Write the audit
nodes.notes:
GPT analyzes the website content and returns 7 structured fields:

1. businessType — what the business does
2. overallScore — 1 to 10 quality score
3. criticalIssues — 3 specific damaging problems
4. quickWins — 3 fast actionable improvements
5. keyRecommendation — the single most important fix
6. estimatedOpportunity — what 3-6 months of work could achieve
7. talkingPoints — 3 specific conversation starters for sales calls

All fields enforced by the Audit Output Parser below.
Output is in $json.output

parameters.text:
=You are a senior SEO and website auditor with 10 years of experience. You review websites and give honest, specific assessments.

Website URL: {{ $json.websiteUrl }}

Page content:
{{ $json.pageContent }}

Analyze this website and return ONLY a valid JSON object. No extra text. No markdown. No backticks.

Required fields:

businessType
One sentence describing what this business does and who their customers are. Under 20 words.

overallScore
A number from 1 to 10 showing the overall quality of this website for conversions and SEO.
1 to 3 means critical problems. 4 to 6 means significant work needed. 7 to 8 means good with room for improvement. 9 to 10 means excellent.

criticalIssues
Array of exactly 3 strings. The most damaging problems on this website that are losing them visitors or customers. Be specific — reference actual content from the page. Each issue under 25 words.

quickWins
Array of exactly 3 strings. Changes that can be made in 1 to 2 weeks that would immediately improve performance. Be specific and actionable. Each win under 25 words.

keyRecommendation
One sentence. The single most impactful improvement this website owner should make first. Under 30 words.

estimatedOpportunity
One sentence. What could realistically be achieved in 3 to 6 months with proper optimization work on this site. Under 30 words.

talkingPoints
Array of exactly 3 strings. Conversation starters a sales or consulting team could use when calling this business owner to offer website or marketing services. Each point should reference a specific problem found on the page and suggest a solution. Each under 30 words.

nodes.name: Chat model
nodes.notes:
Connect your OpenAI API credential here.

1. Go to platform.openai.com/api-keys
2. Create a new key
3. In n8n: Settings → Credentials → Add New → OpenAI API
4. Connect to this node

Model: gpt-4o-mini
temperature: 0.3 for precise, consistent analysis
Cost: about $0.002 per audit

nodes.name: Output Parser - Audit fields
nodes.notes:
Schema: 7 required fields for the website audit.
Ensures GPT always returns clean consistent data.
No changes needed.

nodes.name: Format the reply
nodes.notes:
Reads GPT output from $json.output.
Reads page and config data from Clean HTML node.

Builds a plain text Telegram message with 5 sections:
1. Score and business type
2. Top 3 critical issues
3. 3 quick wins
4. Key recommendation
5. Sales talking points

Safe fallback: if GPT output is missing, returns an error message
so the user always gets a reply.

No changes needed.

nodes.name: Reply with the audit
nodes.notes:
Sends the audit result back to the same Telegram chat that sent the URL.

Connect the same Telegram API credential here.

The chatId comes from the original message — so the reply goes
exactly where the URL was sent from.

nodes.name: Log the audit
nodes.notes:
Logs every audit to Google Sheets permanently.

How to connect:
1. Go to console.cloud.google.com and enable Google Sheets API
2. In n8n: Settings → Credentials → Add New → Google Sheets OAuth2
3. Authenticate and connect to this node

Sheet tab: Website Audits
Row 1 headers:
Date | Website URL | Business Type | Score | Top Issues | Quick Wins | Key Recommendation | Requested By | Logged At

Every audit gets its own row.
Filter by Score to find the worst-performing sites.
Filter by Requested By to see who is using the bot most.

nodes.name: Reply with help
nodes.notes:
Sent when the user types anything other than a URL.

Connect the same Telegram API credential here.

The message explains how to use the bot and gives an example URL.
ChatId comes from Parse Message node so the reply goes to the right chat.

parameters.content:
## 1. Take the message
The bot receives any Telegram message and a Code node looks for a URL in it. Anything that is not a URL gets a short help reply explaining how to use the bot.

## 2. Scrape and audit
The page is fetched with a fifteen second timeout and stripped to plain text, then GPT returns a structured audit: score, business type, top issues, quick wins and a recommendation.

## 3. Log and reply
The audit is formatted for Telegram, written to your sheet first so nothing is lost, then sent back to whoever asked.

# Telegram bot that audits any website with GPT

Paste a website URL into your Telegram bot and get a sales-ready audit back in seconds: an overall score, what kind of business it is, the biggest problems, the quickest wins, and a recommendation you can use as a talking point. Every audit is logged to a Google Sheet, so it doubles as a prospect research log.

### How it works
1. The bot receives any message sent to it. One config node holds your sheet and your name.
2. A Code node looks for a URL in the message and tidies up trailing punctuation.
3. If there is no URL, the sender gets a short help message and nothing else runs.
4. If there is one, the page is fetched with a fifteen second timeout. A blocked or slow site does not crash the run.
5. The HTML is stripped to readable text so only the content reaches the model.
6. GPT returns a structured audit: score, business type, top issues, quick wins and a key recommendation.
7. The audit is formatted for Telegram, written to your sheet, then sent back to whoever asked.

### Setup
1. Message @BotFather on Telegram, send /newbot, and copy the bot token it gives you.
2. Add that token as a Telegram credential and connect it to all three Telegram nodes.
3. Add your OpenAI API key and connect your Google Sheets account.
4. Open Set config and replace the sheet ID and your name.
5. Create a tab called Website Audits with headers for Date, Website URL, Business Type, Score, Top Issues, Quick Wins, Key Recommendation and Requested By.

### Customization
Edit the agent prompt to audit for a specific angle, such as accessibility or ecommerce conversion.
